data.fund_type: An open ended debt scheme predominantly investing in ﬂoating rate instruments. A relatively high interest rate risk andmoderate credit risk.
data.investment_objective: The primary objective of the Scheme is to generate income through investment primarily in ﬂoating rate debt instruments, ﬁxedrate debt instruments swapped for ﬂoating rate returns and money market instruments. However, there is no assurance orguarantee that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved.
